interface_debt.why: The public packet header size and layout change when this build macro is toggled, so user code that uses sizeof, allocates packet buffers, or indexes ApidQ must be revalidated or changed whenever CFE changes the default or adds another header version.
interface_debt.better: Expose a stable, versioned header type with a fixed maximum size or explicit version field and accessors, rather than conditionally adding a member to the public struct.
interface_debt.title: cFE:fsw/cfe-core/src/inc/ccsds.h: CCSDS_SpacePacket_t — a declaration whose meaning or signature is likely to change

interface_debt.why: The telemetry secondary header is a raw byte array whose length is selected by mission configuration; users that allocate packet space, copy headers, or read Time[] directly must change if CFE changes the time format or CCSDS_TIME_SIZE.
interface_debt.better: Represent the time field as an opaque fixed-size field with accessor functions and a stable header size, or provide versioned header types for each time format.
interface_debt.title: cFE:fsw/cfe-core/src/inc/ccsds.h: CCSDS_TlmSecHdr_t::Time — users reach into the layout of a type (public struct or union members)

interface_debt.why: The primary header exposes the wire bytes as public array members, so user code can and likely does touch StreamId[] directly; any future change to the word size, alignment, or bit packing forces those users to change even if the logical fields stay the same.
interface_debt.better: Hide the bytes and expose only logical field accessors or an opaque header with stable accessors.
interface_debt.title: cFE:fsw/cfe-core/src/inc/ccsds.h: CCSDS_PriHdr_t::StreamId — users reach into the layout of a type (public struct or union members)

interface_debt.better: Implement field access as functions or a stable accessor interface that can change implementation without changing the public byte layout contract.

interface_debt.better: Provide a length accessor function or opaque header writer that encapsulates the encoding and can evolve with the wire format.

interface_debt.better: Remove the deprecated aliases or provide a clearly versioned compatibility layer that can be dropped without changing the active packet types.
